description: The REAL iterative-resolution delegation chain for example.com: root → .com TLD → authoritative. The dnsres-sim runs this as a state machine — a root server REFERS to the .com TLD servers (it never answers a leaf A record); the .com TLD server REFERS to example.com's authoritative NS; only the authoritative server answers. Routing a leaf query to root/TLD yields the real referral.

provenance.captured_with: dig (system resolver), this session (2026-06-13): `.` root list, `dig com NS` for the .com TLD servers, `dig example.com NS` for the authoritative NS, `dig +short a.root-servers.net` and `dig +short a.gtld-servers.net` for the IPs
provenance.verified_against: IANA root-server list (root-servers.org / iana.org/domains/root/servers): a.root-servers.net = 198.41.0.4. The .com TLD NS list (a.gtld-servers.net … m.gtld-servers.net), a.gtld-servers.net = 192.5.6.30, captured TTL 11246. example.com's authoritative NS at capture = elliott.ns.cloudflare.com / hera.ns.cloudflare.com.
provenance.honesty_note: Real delegation data. The referral targets and the accepted hand-off order are the protocol's behaviour run by the state machine, not an answer key.
